import json, random, subprocess, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, "/app/work")
import gen, check

def main(n=200, seed=1):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    reqs = [gen.gen(rng) for _ in range(n)]
    payload = "".join(json.dumps(r) + "\n" for r in reqs).encode()
    t0 = time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "/app/submission/planner.py"],
                       input=payload, capture_output=True, timeout=900)
    t1 = time.time()
    assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr.decode()[-3000:]
    lines = p.stdout.decode().splitlines()
    if len(lines) != len(reqs):
        print("LINE COUNT MISMATCH", len(lines), len(reqs)); return 1
    nfail = 0
    stats = {"optimal": 0, "infeasible": 0, "invalid": 0}
    for i, (req, line) in enumerate(zip(reqs, lines)):
        resp = json.loads(line)
        stats[resp.get("status", "?")] = stats.get(resp.get("status", "?"), 0) + 1
        errs = check.check(req, resp, verbose=False)
        if errs:
            nfail += 1
            print("case %d FAILED: %s" % (i, errs))
            print("  req:", json.dumps(req)[:600])
            if nfail > 6:
                break
    print("checked %d cases in %.1fs; failures=%d; stats=%s" % (n, t1 - t0, nfail, stats))
    if p.stderr.strip():
        print("STDERR:", p.stderr.decode()[:2000])
    return nfail

if __name__ == "__main__":
    n = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 200
    seed = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 1
    sys.exit(1 if main(n, seed) else 0)
